purpose: Capture the full authorizationType enum (4 values) and MCP auth DataPart processing rules — deferred from A1B-AE.1 §1.2.
sections_captured: Token example (for authorizationType=bearer or inherit override)

fields.name: transportType
fields.note: full enum likely sse+stdio per MCP spec; not confirmed on this page; REVERSE_ENGINEERED tier observation in A1B-AE.7 will confirm

mcp_server_registration_schema_PUBLIC.discrepancy_with_A1B_AE_1_section_4_1: A1B-AE.1 §4.1 captured the Agent-create MCP schema with fields {name, url, description, authorizationScope, redirectUrl, token}. The mcp-authentication page schema is {name, transportType, authorizationType, url}. These appear to be TWO DIFFERENT MCP registration paths: (a) Agent-create inline MCP registration (OAuth2 redirect flow with token write-only), (b) Expert-config MCP registration (direct transport with transportType+authorizationType). iCoDer A1B-AE.3+ MUST support BOTH shapes.

none.semantics: No authentication; MCP server is fully public.

inherit.semantics: MCP server inherits the calling agent's authorization (typically the user's session token).

bearer.semantics: Static bearer token provided via DataPart at thread creation (NOT stored at MCP registration time).

oauth2.0.semantics: OAuth2 client_credentials flow; client_id+client_secret provided via DataPart at thread creation.

fields.name: data.mcp_name
fields.note: MCP server name as registered; case-SENSITIVE; trimmed

processing_rules_PUBLIC: type is normalized to lowercase; only token and credentials are extracted
DataParts do NOT change the MCP server authorizationType — the DataPart type MUST match the server configuration
Unknown or invalid auth DataParts are LEFT IN the message as normal parts (not silently dropped; not fatal)
mcp_name MUST be unique per message; duplicates return error code mcp_auth_duplicate_name
Missing fields return: mcp_auth_missing_name | mcp_auth_missing_token | mcp_auth_missing_credentials
If mcp_name does not match any configured server, the DataPart is ignored
datapart_lifecycle_rules_PUBLIC: MCP tools are registered when a new thread is created (the first message). Auth DataParts MUST be on that first message.
Later messages on the same thread do NOT re-register tools; auth DataParts are ignored for MCP registration on subsequent messages.
In the API flow, extracted auth DataParts are REMOVED from the message before it is stored or sent to reasoning.
implications_for_icoder_a1b_ae_3: iCoDer Expert model MUST store authorization_type ∈ {none, inherit, bearer, oauth2.0} on its mcp_server[] entries.
iCoDer Expert model SHOULD store transport_type ∈ {streamable_http, sse, stdio} (TBD via RE observation).
iCoDer MUST implement the mcp_auth_* error code family on the message:send path (A1B-AE.5).
iCoDer MUST implement the thread-first-message auth DataPart extraction + subsequent-message-ignore rule (A1B-AE.5).
iCoDer MUST strip auth DataParts before persisting the message (defensive; prevents accidental token logging).

iCoDer MCP server registration API MUST accept BOTH the Agent-create schema (token write-only) AND the Expert-config schema (transportType + authorizationType) — these are two legitimate Corti public contract shapes.
